full_judgment: 2. The petitioner as complainant lodged a complaint against accused opposite parties alleging commission of an offence of forgery, interpolation, wrongful gain and criminal misconduct. The learned Senior Special Judge on receipt of the petition of complaint examined the complainant under section 200 of the Code of Criminal Procedure and registered the case as Special Case No. 13 of 2001 and by order dated 12-9-2001 directed to write to the Government for sanction as out of 10 accused 6 of them happened to be public servants fixing 25-11-2001 for further orders. On 25-11-2001 the District Anti-Corruption Bureau, Sunamgonj filed an application praying for time for submitting the order of sanction and the learned Senior Special Judge fixed 15-1-2002 for receipt of the order of sanction, if any. On 10-1-2002 however, an application was filed by the complainant petitioner stating, inter alia, that since 60 days already expired from the date of moving the authority for sanction but the sanction had not yet been received proceeding should be started against the public servants presuming that sanction had been obtained. The learned Senior Special Judge fixed the application for hearing on the date already fixed previously (i.e. 15-1-2002). On 15-1-2002 a letter bearing No. 23 40 04 6502 12, 2201-67 (6) dated refusing to accord the sanction to prosecute the public servants and the matter was thus fixed for hearing on 28-1-2002. On 28-1-2002 the learned Senior Special Judge observing that sanction had been refused against accused parties they had been absolved by him and by the same order fixed 13-2-2002 for hearing as to taking cognizance against other accused.
